assertions.assertion: Reads the source ASP.NET Identity DB and calls IUserImporter.ImportAsync with UserImportRecord(s) (does not use a non-existent AddAspNetIdentityMigration option)
assertions.rationale: Generic batch import script advice; no IUserImporter or UserImportRecord.

assertions.assertion: Stores existing hashes via PasswordImport(HashedPasswordData) and registers a custom IPasswordHashAlgorithm (AddPasswordHashAlgorithm<T>) to verify them, with re-hash on first successful login
assertions.rationale: Suggests lazy migration conceptually but no PasswordImport/HashedPasswordData or IPasswordHashAlgorithm registration.

assertions.assertion: Mentions re-runs skip existing users by default, and an IUserImportConflictResolver can overwrite
assertions.rationale: No mention of re-run skipping or IUserImportConflictResolver.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that after migration users can enroll in passwordless methods
assertions.rationale: Only vaguely mentions sending users through OTP/passkey enrollment as an alternative; does not state users can enroll in passwordless methods after migration.
